📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Nioh 3 has received a hot latest update that brings plenty of bug fixes to very specific complications, but it also implements fixes for a few of the most common - and incredibly annoying - bugs. Patch 1.03.01 arrived earlier on all platforms, and it comes with a chunky set of notes.

This latest upgrade, predictably, doesn’t add any gameplay features, but some of the included fixes will absolutely delight - or vindicate - so many of the game’s millions of players.

There’s plenty to go through in the patch notes published today for update 1.03.01, but the most impactful is a fix for an issue that “sometimes made it impossible to use elixirs during battle.” This is only a partial fix, but if you ran into the problem of smashing that shortcut button and not seeing your character play the healing animation, you’ll be glad to see it.

Sources indicate that this is a problem myself and others have faced, especially in boss fights. You can even see the shortcut register your button press and proceed to ignore you. Another partial fix has been made to an glitch that caused the game to crash. Team Ninja didn’t share specifics on that, and though Nioh 3 has been fairly stable for me in 70+ hours, it has definitely crashed a few times.

If you’ve been playing since launch, you likely have - or know someone who has - run into problems with save file corruption and other weird bugs around certain trackable items within save files.

Team Ninja already rolled out a couple of fixes there, and this latest one specifically targets losing valuables during Myths. If your save file has been affected, the game will now check and recover what was lost. Even more interesting is that the game will now automatically create a backup copy of your save data any time you load a save.

If you’ve made it into the Eternal Rift, you’ll be happy to know that today’s enhancement takes care of a few progression blockers, and fixes an matter that allowed some players to obtain certain items before they were supposed to, locking themselves out.

One of the more amusing fixes concerns Mujina, who had a tendency to respawn if you prayed at a Shrine after opening a chest it was hiding in, which made it appear far more often than a mimic should.

According to recent reports, finally, there’s a set of fixes that address bugs (and exploits) when using specific Martial Art with certain weapons. There are a few fixes to AI, Myths, and one problem with the Minamoto no Yoritomo boss fight that made it impossible to interrupt him, even after he runs out of Ki.

According to recent reports, hit the link at the top for the full change log, and check out our Nioh 3 gameplay tips if you haven’t already. You should also change these settings ASAP, as they’re going to make your life much easier and save you a lot of time.

#143607. U.S. loses measles elimination status after 25 years as vaccine myths persist

📅 23 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 7m • 📚 Deep Dive (1306 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Sciencedaily ↗ Open Full Page

U.S. loses measles elimination status after 25 years as vaccine myths persist

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1306 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • The United States has lost its measles elimination status after more than 25 years, marking a major setback in the fight against a highly contagious disease.
  • Sources indicate that the United States first achieved measles elimination status in 2000.
  • According to recent reports, the announcement comes during the country's worst measles resurgence in decades.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The United States has lost its measles elimination status after more than 25 years, marking a major setback in the fight against a highly contagious disease. At the same time, a new nationwide survey from the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) reveals that many Americans remain confused about the dangers of measles and the vaccines that protect against it.

Sources indicate that the United States first achieved measles elimination status in 2000. This designation meant that no strain of the virus had spread continuously within the country for 12 months or longer. However, on Nov. 17, 2026, the Pan American Health Organization confirmed that the United States no longer qualified for that status.

According to recent reports, the announcement comes during the country's worst measles resurgence in decades. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the United States had recorded 5,412 confirmed cases in 2026 as of Nov. 12. That is more than twice the 2,290 cases reported throughout all of 2025.

Vaccine Myths Persist Despite Decades of Scientific Evidence.

Recent findings suggest that A November 2026 Annenberg Science and Public Health (ASAPH) survey, conducted using adults from the SSRS Omnibus survey, highlights widespread misunderstandings about childhood vaccination. Nearly two-thirds of Americans (64%) correctly rejected the claim that "vaccines given to children for diseases like measles, mumps, and rubella cause autism." However, 17% believed the claim was true, while another 19% said they did not know whether it was true or false.

The results closely resemble findings from earlier APPC research. Across four surveys involving a separate sample of U.S. adults (September 2024 to August 2026), the ongoing ASAPH national probability survey found that 65% to 68% correctly rejected a connection between childhood vaccines and autism (65%-68%). Another 12% to 14% incorrectly believed there was a connection (12%-14%), while 19% to 22% remained uncertain.

It has been revealed that the latest survey also asked respondents to compare autism rates among fully vaccinated and unvaccinated children. Nearly half (49%) believed both groups were "about as likely" to show signs of autism. Another 11% thought fully vaccinated children were "more likely" to show signs, 14% believed they were "less likely," and 26% could not say.

Recent findings suggest that extensive scientific research has found no evidence that vaccines cause autism. In 2004, the National Academy of Medicine (then named the Institute of Medicine) concluded that "the body of epidemiological evidence favors rejection of a causal relationship between the MMR vaccine and autism evidence.".

It has been revealed that the World Health Organization's Global Advisory Committee on Vaccine Safety reached the same conclusion in 2025, reaffirming that high-quality scientific evidence does not establish a causal relationship between vaccination and autism. FactCheck.org, which is operated by the Annenberg Public Policy Center, has also challenged claims linking vaccines to autism, explaining that the evidence does not support them.

Industry observers note that these misconceptions may have consequences for vaccination decisions. Previous Annenberg research found that people who accept false vaccine claims, including the belief that the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine causes autism, are less likely to recommend MMR vaccination to people who are eligible to receive it.

Only 9% of Americans Know How Deadly Measles Can Be.

The survey uncovered another striking knowledge gap. Most Americans appear uncertain about the risk of death associated with measles in children.

In a recent development, when asked how many children infected with measles are likely to die from the disease, 59% of respondents said they did not know. Just 9% selected the correct response, "about 1 in 1,000," which most closely matches the CDC’s estimate that 1 to 3 of every 1,000 infected children die from respiratory or neurological complications.

Nearly one-quarter of respondents (23%) underestimated the death rate, while another 9% selected a higher rate.

Knowledge about measles vaccination was also limited. Almost half of Americans (49%) said they were unsure how many doses children need for full protection. Only about one-third (34%) correctly identified the recommended two-dose schedule.

The CDC advises giving children their first MMR vaccine dose between 12 and 15 months of age, followed by a second dose between ages 4 and 6. According to CDC data, a single dose provides 93% protection against measles, while receiving both doses increases effectiveness to 97%.

Public Confidence in Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Remains Low.

The survey also examined Americans' trust in U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The findings indicate that public confidence in his health-related communications has changed little since earlier surveys conducted in 2025 and 2026.

In a recent development, in November 2026, about six in 10 respondents (61%) said they were not confident that Kennedy was providing trustworthy information about public health. The remaining four in 10 (39%) expressed confidence in the information he provides.

In a recent development, these results are consistent with seven earlier national probability surveys conducted over two years (February 2025 to August 2026). During that period, 60% to 63% of respondents reported lacking confidence in Kennedy, while 37% to 39% expressed confidence.

Kathleen Hall Jamieson, director of the Annenberg Public Policy Center's Science of Science Communication Institute and its ASAPH and ASK surveys, noted the loss of measles elimination status demonstrates the consequences of declining vaccination coverage.

Industry observers note that "The announcement that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status confirms what we already knew," stated Kathleen Hall Jamieson. "Those who refused the MMR vaccine for themselves or their children and those who misled them into doing so have produced the tragic effects that science predicted would occur when community immunity dropped below the threshold needed to protect those who are not able to be vaccinated or refused to be.".

How the National Measles Survey Was Conducted.

The findings draw on two types of Annenberg Science and Public Health (ASAPH) surveys.

The November 2026 results come from a nationally representative survey of 1,028 U.S. adults conducted for APPC by SSRS, an independent market research organization. Participants were selected from the tech giant's probability-based online opinion panel, and responses were collected Nov. 6-8, 2026. The survey has a margin of sampling error (MOE) of ± 3.5 percentage points at the 95% confidence level.

The other findings come from APPC's ongoing ASAPH panel surveys, which are also administered by SSRS. Participants were originally recruited through probability sampling from the SSRS Opinion Panel, and their responses are weighted to reflect the U.S. adult population. This research panel operates separately from the SSRS Omnibus survey and has completed more than 30 survey waves since April 2021.

Percentages are rounded to the nearest whole number, so totals may not always equal 100%.

Sources indicate that additional results are available in the survey topline, which includes data from both the November 2026 omnibus survey and the ongoing ASAPH panel surveys. A separate methodology statement provides further details about the latest survey.

Since April 2021, the Annenberg Public Policy Center has used its Annenberg Science and Public Health (ASAPH) research program and separate national samples to monitor Americans' knowledge, attitudes, and behaviors related to vaccines, Covid-19, influenza, RSV, and other notable health issues.

The APPC health survey team includes Ken Winneg, managing director of survey research; Laura A. Gibson, research analyst; and Patrick E. Jamieson, director of the Annenberg Health and Risk Communication Institute.

In a recent development, the Sentinels lineup for 2027 now reads johnqt, brawk, OXY, canezerra and keiko. Zellsis rounds out the group as sixth man. He came back to the organisation on 7 November in that role and as a content creator. Contract lengths were not disclosed.

In a recent development, keiko’s NRG spell ran from 12 November 2025 to 21 October 2026. He finished third at Masters Santiago 2026. He also placed third in both VCT Americas Stage 1 and Stage 2. At Champions 2026 he finished joint fifth to sixth.

Industry observers note that that spell ended once Champions was over. NRG told him he would not be kept for the following year, keiko said on X on 21 October. He was then free to look for a newly introduced team as a restricted free agent.

Sentinels reached no international event in 2026. The team went out of that year’s Kickoff in the bottom four. It then missed the playoffs in both Stage 1 and Stage 2. Adding a player with that run of results is consistent with a side trying to close the gap quickly.

In a recent development, keiko was born on 12 September 2003. He grew up in and around London. He played competitive Fortnite before switching to VALORANT. His VALORANT career began at UK sides WYLDE, from May to August 2022, and BONK, from October to December 2022. He then joined Apeks from January to November 2023. That year he won the Challengers Rising Stars award. Team Liquid followed, from November 2023 to November 2025. His move to Sentinels places a British player at the centre of a rebuilt Americas contender.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • The latest substantial content revision has been revealed for HoYoverse's breakout game, Genshin Impact.
  • This one is a bit of a nostalgia play, taking everyone back to Mondstadt, the place where you may remember taking your first steps.
  • Industry observers note that the major new arrival is Varka, who joins as a playable character for the first time.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The latest substantial content revision has been revealed for HoYoverse's breakout game, Genshin Impact. Version Luna 5, which has the unusually long and needlessly layered title — Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation - Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind — is set to arrive February 25.

This one is a bit of a nostalgia play, taking everyone back to Mondstadt, the place where you may remember taking your first steps. And, as with any good return to the ol’ hunting grounds, come familiar characters, too.

Industry observers note that the major new arrival is Varka, who joins as a playable character for the first time. Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, is a character whose debut has been long-awaited. He is a 5-Star Anemo Claymore wielder with a dual-wield combat style, capable of dealing two different types of Elemental damage. His addition means that there's now finally a burly 5-Star male character of each elemental type... do with that information what you will.

In a recent development, varka's dual-wielding combat style allows him to deal two different types of Elemental damage at the same time. The way it works is that his Elemental Skill boosts the damage of his regular attacks, but it also converts the damage type of his right-hand claymore to match his teammates’ elements (Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo). The left-hand claymore always deals Anemo damage.

Recent findings suggest that the more normal attacks you use, the more frequently he can activate a special Elemental Skill, or trigger a Charged Attack that doesn’t consume stamina. He can also rely on the Hexerei effect to trigger more instances of Elemental Skill, as well as Charged Attacks, making him a monster damage-dealer.

Varka, of course, has been a staple member of the cast, featuring in both the original story in a small cameo, as well as taking a bigger role in the recent Nod-Krai chapters. With the return to Mondstadt, his playable debut makes sense. His Story Quest will shed light on his encounter with the Wild Hunt, and the Great Wolf King of the North.

The reruns for this version are going to be Flins — who will be available in the first phase of Event Wishes — as well as Skirk and Escoffier in the second phase. You can also look forward to the return of the Chronicled Wish with Mondstadt characters.

Staying on the theme of reminiscence, the major event in Luna 5 is centered around revisiting memories from the beginning of your time with Genshin Impact, and reuniting with old friends. In Echoes of Memory, you’ll witness familiar scenes that have been changed slightly, and you’ll need to use the Spotter Kamera to detect and record those differences.

The Knights of Favonius are hosting several other activities for everyone to take part in, including an event that lets you catch up with old friends over drinks which you make for them.

Outside of events, there’s a fresh set of Gliding and Combat Challenges. And, of course, there are new minigames that you can relax with. The Kamera is being utilised yet again, and this time you can use to capture sights from your time in spots across Natlan, Fontaine, and Sumeru. There’s also… a horde mode of a sort, where you fend off waves of enemies.

Catch up on the latest set of Genshin Impact codes before you play, and check out why we think Genshin Impact is one of the best mobile games you can play today.

Mice slept 70% less after scientists switched off these brain cells

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (901 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that why does being awake for too long make us increasingly desperate for sleep?
  • In a recent development, the longer we go without sleep, the more difficult it becomes to stay awake.
  • Industry observers note that researchers led by Professor Alex Schier at the Biozentrum, University of Basel, have now identified brain cells that help regulate this process.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that why does being awake for too long make us increasingly desperate for sleep? Scientists at the University of Basel in Switzerland have identified two groups of brain cells in mice that become more active the longer the animals remain awake. These neurons play a critical role in creating the pressure to sleep, offering upcoming clues about how the brain regulates our need for rest.

In a recent development, the longer we go without sleep, the more difficult it becomes to stay awake. This buildup of sleep pressure, often called sleep drive, helps ensure that extended periods of wakefulness are followed by longer and deeper sleep. Although sleep is essential for survival, exactly how the brain measures time spent awake and converts that information into an increasing need for sleep has remained a mystery.

Industry observers note that researchers led by Professor Alex Schier at the Biozentrum, University of Basel, have now identified brain cells that help regulate this process. The work was conducted in collaboration with scientists from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and Auburn University.

In a recent development, "We have identified neuronal populations that monitor prolonged wakefulness and actively promote sleep," states Alex Schier. "This is an crucial missing piece of the puzzle in understanding why we become sleepy.".

Scientists Identify Brain Cells That Drive Sleep Pressure.

Industry observers note that to investigate how sleep pressure develops, the team studied patterns of brain activity in mice under three different conditions: normal cycles of sleeping and waking, extended sleep deprivation, and recovery sleep. By comparing these patterns, they identified brain regions whose activity changed according to how long the animals had been awake.

Industry observers note that within one of these regions, the brainstem, researchers pinpointed two groups of neurons involved in controlling sleep drive. Known as GABAergic and serotonergic neurons, both groups became progressively more active as the mice remained awake. Their activity then decreased once the animals fell asleep.

The next question was whether these neurons simply tracked how long the mice had been awake or actually helped create the growing need for sleep.

Sources indicate that experiments revealed that the neurons were directly involved in driving sleep. When researchers artificially activated both groups, the mice slept longer and more deeply, showing the same type of recovery sleep normally seen after extended wakefulness. When the neurons were inhibited, however, the animals slept substantially less and were able to remain awake and alert.

In a recent development, "These neurons do not simply signal that an animal has been awake," says Schier. "Our experiments show that they are crucial to promote sleep, and that they may be key components of the neural circuitry that generates sleep drive.".

It has been revealed that the results provide particularly strong evidence that certain neurons activated during wakefulness do more than register lost sleep. They actively help generate the pressure that eventually pushes the brain toward sleep.

Mice Sleep 70% Less When Key Neurons Are Inhibited.

Recent findings suggest that further experiments produced an especially surprising result. When scientists suppressed both groups of neurons for an extended period, the mice slept approximately 70% less than normal.

In a recent development, even more unexpectedly, most of these animals did not display some of the serious behavioral problems typically associated with prolonged sleep deprivation. Despite getting dramatically less sleep, many avoided impairments that researchers would ordinarily expect.

These findings suggest that the identified neurons influence not only the amount of time animals spend sleeping, but also how strongly the pressure to sleep increases during wakefulness.

Rather than simply responding to exhaustion, the brain appears to use specific neural circuits to actively regulate the growing need for rest.

A Upcoming Direction for Sleep Research.

Understanding these circuits could open key new avenues for studying sleep and its effects on the body. Researchers now hope to determine how the identified neurons communicate with other brain regions and what molecular processes allow them to generate sleep pressure.

"Future studies could reveal how these neurons interact with the rest of the brain, and how sleep drive is generated at the molecular level," claims Dr. William Joo, first author of the study. "Our ability to stably transform sleep behavior also allows us to explore adaptations to long-term sleep loss - this may eventually reveal ways to confer resilience to sleep deprivation and other physiological challenges.".

The findings establish that GABAergic and serotonergic neurons in the brainstem become increasingly active during prolonged wakefulness and play an essential role in promoting sleep.

Recent findings suggest that determining exactly how the brain makes sleep increasingly difficult to resist remains a major objective of sleep research. Beyond improving scientists' understanding of sleep disorders, this discovery could help explain how the nervous system adapts to extended wakefulness and other physical challenges.

Ultimately, a clearer understanding of the brain circuits responsible for sleep pressure could inspire new treatments and potentially reveal ways to improve resilience to sleep deprivation.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Every game, every genre, all of the Apple Arcade essentials you need to know about.

According to recent reports, if you get spoiled for choice when browsing through the Apple Arcade library, we can't blame you. There are well over 100 games in the incredible service, and you can spend hundreds of hours playing through them all. So the question is, where is best to spend your time? What is Apple Arcade? Apple Arcade is a subscription service that you can use on all of your Apple devices, including your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV or Mac. It allows you to play games from a list that includes over 180 games at the moment, and your progress is transferred between devices, meaning you can continue where you left off. It's really handy, and the Apple Arcade games list gets expanded often, so you'll always have new games to play.

It has been revealed that no matter what kind of game you're looking for, you'll find it on these pages. Here we've put together a comprehensive Apple Arcade games list of every title presently released, in the order of release, with the genres included so you can find exactly what you want.

Apple Arcade games list 2026 Just take a look below, and you'll find everything you need to know about every game that's on the Apple Arcade games list of 2026, sorted by genre and release date (latest first).

Crossy Road Rush (Hipster Whale).

Hipster Whale's blocky Frogger-like is running down a different path in Crossy Road Rush. Now, you'll dash across an island, hopping from place to place while trying to avoid colliding with walls and other obstacles.

Yes, the beloved survival crafting game is now available on Apple Arcade, complete with Dead Cells and Palworld crossover content.

River City Survivors (Arc System Works).

Get a healthy dose of bullet heaven in River City Survivors, which sees you slaying zombies while picking up equipment and synergies along the way.

Indulge in some classic arcade games like Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Galaga and a whole lot more.

Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm+ (Bandai Namco).

With controller support and dozens of characters, you can enjoy battles and stories from Naruto.

Recent findings suggest that ever wanted to start your own cult? Well, now you have to. After being saved by an ominous stranger, you'll have to repay your debt by gathering him newly introduced and loyal followers. It won't be easy, though. You'll need to battle off hordes of enemies and take down other cult leaders to help boost your own.

Recent findings suggest that ah, Worms. For people of a certain age, it was a staple of their childhoods. Creating your little worm troop and then sending them into battle against your pals was always a joy. Now a newly introduced version is available on Apple Arcade, bringing those same turn-based tactics to the palm of your hand.

Everyone's favourite grumpy avians are back with a slight twist. Rather than flinging themselves at their porcine foes, this time you'll take down the piggies in a brick breaker-style setup. Okay, so there's still an element of flinging.

Industry observers note that much like Triband's previous efforts, What the Clash? is another wacky fun time that sees you competing – either solo or co-op – in numerous party games.

SpaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo (Taito Corporation).

Industry observers note that spaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo is, as the name suggests, an evolved version of the classic arcade shooter. Sporting the gameplay we all know and love, it throws in a few twists to help breathe fresh life into this familiar setup.

Katamari Damacy Rolling Live (Bandai Namco).

Everything you need to know is pretty much in the title. Katamari Damacy sees you rolling a stick ball that grows bigger as more and more items become stuck to it.

Pac-Man continues to be relevant in the gaming world and 256+ allows you to enjoy even more dot-munching action.

In a recent development, drive Ahead! Carcade (Dodreams Fairytale Manufacturer).

Sources indicate that ever have the urge to drive recklessly? Well, here you can live out those bizarre fantasies with no real-world consequences! In Cardcade, the goal is to bonk your opponent in the head once. Yep, that's all it takes, which means it's not as simple as it sounds in practice.

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ (Taito Corporation).

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ combines the two classic games in one, tasking you with defending the Earth by deflecting bullets back at your foes.

Poncle's excellent Vampire Survivors is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's a bullet heaven game where your character automatically flings a barrage of projectiles at your enemies, leaving you only worrying about walking away from any incoming danger.

Temple Run: Legends (Imangi Studios).

Sources indicate that one of the most iconic mobile games is back, albeit with a slight twist. In Temple Run: Legends, there are levels to complete rather than the endless dash we're used to. On each, there are three stars to earn on the one-hundred-plus levels, so your swiping skills need to be on point.

Punch Kick Duck+ (Shaun Coleman).

Battle your way to the top of the tower where success lies in how good your timing is and whether or not you pick the right move.

Tomb of the Mask+ (Happymagenta).

Tomb of the Mask is an arcade action game that sees you exploring a tomb.

A Slight Chance of Sawblades+ (Yong Kian Chin).

In a strange and dangerous turn of events, it's raining saw blades. To survive the deadly storm, you must dodge, jump and backflip away from the tools dropping from the sky.

BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team (Oh BiBi).

Beast is a 3v3 shooter that sees you battling for the honour of your home planet. During each match, you can switch between pet and beast forms, making use of the different abilities and weapons each brings.

Everyone's favourite speed hedgehog comes to Apple Arcade to do battle with his old foe Eggman. Choosing one of six playable characters, you will dash, climb, and fly your way through each of the stages.

As the name heavily suggests, Downwell sees you making your way down a well in search of treasure. To defend yourself, you are equipped with a pair of Gunboots to vanquish the threats that lurk within the well.

Taken on the role of James Bond in this top-down action adventure that draws inspiration from the last 60 years of the storied hero.

Junkworld is a tower defence where you take charge of the Scavenger clan and lead them to victory in a series of battle, making use of towers, special units and gadgets.

Ridiculous Fishing EX (Vlambeer).

A fishing game with a difference, Ridiculous Fishing EX sees you using guns, chainsaws, and even toasters as you head into the depths in search of a massive catch.

TMNT Splintered Fate (Viacom International).

In a recent development, join everyone's favourite turtle quartet in this brand-new roguelike action game. Splinter has been captured and it's up to you to save him. You can play as any of the four Turtles, each with distinct abilities and powers alongside teaming up with three other players.

Time Locker is a shooter with a minimalist but colourful aesthetic. In it, you control the speed of time using your finger and must avoid obstacles and enemy attacks. The Apple Arcade version comes with latest exclusive enemies.

Temple Run is one of mobile gaming's all-time classics. If, somehow, you're unfamiliar, it sees you running, jumping, and sliding through temples, collecting riches as you go.

Snake.io+ is a battle royale that sees you slithering around and eating pellets in a bid to become the last serpent standing. By cutting up other snakes, you can make them explode into pellets, which you'll want to gobble up to increase your size.

In a recent development, PPKP stands for Punch Punch Kick Punch, which gives you a rough idea of what to expect. You will attempt to save a city from deadly monsters by honing your martial arts skills so you can unleash a devastating combo to defeat them.

Getting Over It+(Bennett Foddy).

Navigate a world covered in random everyday objects by playing as a man in a pot wielding a hammer. It's as frustrating as it is odd, but ultimately rewarding if you manage to scale the mountain that lies ahead of you.

JellyCar Worlds (Walaber Entertainment).

Industry observers note that as the title suggests, in this driving/platforming action game, you play as a car made of bouncy jelly. With this in mind and armed with several abilities, the aim is simple. Navigate each level and find the exit.

According to recent reports, motion Twins' excellent roguelike can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you playing as a failed experiment, setting off to explore wildly different biomes.

Jetpack Joyride 2 (Halfbrick Studios).

Barry Streakfries has returned. Once more, he will need to battle through the laboratory and attempt to put an end to the experiments being carried out there.

Subway Surfers Tag (Sybo Games).

The latest entry in the popular Subway Surfers series is an Apple Arcade exclusive. In Subway Surfers Tag, you will head to numerous city locations and skate, grind, and tag your way to a high score. The Guard will be there to make things more tricky though, so be ready to evade him.

Industry observers note that pick your favourite Sonic the Hedgehog character before running, jumping and dashing through plenty of levels. Alongside regular running levels, you will also face off against Eggman and Zac in special Boss Racing stages.

Alto's Adventure – Remastered (Snowman).

Alto's Adventure is a mobile classic that sees players embarking on a snowboarding adventure where they'll grind over rooftops and leap across perilous chasms. The remastered version includes fresh challenges for players to tackle and several new set pieces.

Disney Melee Mania (Mighty Bear Games).

Disney Melee Mania is a MOBA that features a variety of characters from the franchise's many popular films. Each match lasts five minutes, making it great for playing on the go, and there are currently 12 Champions to choose from, including Buzz Lightyear and Wreck-It Ralph.

In a recent development, oddmar sees the titular character embarking on a journey to prove himself worthy of a place in Valhalla. Along the way, he will collect magically imbued weapons and shields that will help him smite down his foes.

Get a blast of nostalgia with Galaga Wars+, which sees you taking control of the iconic spaceships and gunning down waves and waves of enemies.

Sources indicate that play as a cute bird who has always dreamed of flying. Run down hills to use them as jumps to soar through the air, if only for a moment.

The extremely popular Crossy Road is now available on Apple Arcade, allowing you to collect all the characters and the numerous stages as part of your subscription.

The popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Fly through several levels using a bullet-powered jetpack as Barry Steakfries looks to put an end to a group of scientists who are up to no good.

Alto's Odyssey: The Lost City is the definitive version of the gorgeous endless runner. It features an all-new biome for players to explore alongside additional challenges to beat.

Sources indicate that the classic slingshot action game returns with newly introduced birds, pigs and challenges. There's also a brand new game mode to enjoy where players are tasked with stopping the Eagles from wreaking havoc on the island.

Leo's Fortune is a platformer where you will hunt down a fiend who rudely stole your gold. The game has received a lot of praise since it first launched, and now you can play it as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

A retro-fueled underwater adventure where you can create your own soundtrack.

Compete with players from around the world in hyper-casual competitive mini-games or throw a Super Mega Mini Party with friends!

This is an action driving game where you'll be swerving around corners, collecting newly introduced powers, and shooting down choppers, all while zipping past bullets.

Bleak Sword is a dark fantasy action game tasking players to struggle across compact, cursed diorama battlefields.

The floor is lava, so you'd best stay off it any way you can.

Build your way to the top in this lighthearted, team-action brawler where anything can happen.

Creatures of the Deep+ (Infinite Dreams Inc).

Industry observers note that fancy going fishing? That's exactly what you can do in Creatures of the Deep, heading out in your little boat in search of an impressive catch. But be aware that disturbing shadows are lurking in the deep...

Oceanhorn 3 (Cornfox & Brothers).

According to recent reports, the third main instalment in the Zelda-like series takes place 1000 years after Oceanhorn 2, bringing you a completely new adventure. You'll have to battle through the Shadow Sea, which doesn't sound like a pleasant place for a cruise.

SpongeBob: Patty Pursuit (Viacom).

According to recent reports, head down to Bikini Bottom for some side-scrolling action with everyone's favourite sponge. He's on a mission to find his missing fry cook station while Plankton joins him because his inventions have also been stolen.

Return to Monkey Island+ (Terrible Toybox).

This one's for the point-and-click adventure fans out there, particularly those who have previously enjoyed Ron Gilbert's work.

In this adventure, you'll form a team of Ubisoft's critters and use their special powers to vanquish your foes.

Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom (Bandai Namco Entertainment).

In this colourful game, your goal is to restore the titular kingdom to its former glory by building and decorating your wilderness camp before inviting your Tamagotchi pals to enjoy it with you.

According to recent reports, from the creators of What the Golf? Comes What the Car?, a silly racing game where you can roll, jump, fly and even sneeze your way to the finish line. You play as a car, but rather than having wheels, you have a pair of legs. It's as fun as it is absurd.

Very Little Nightmares+ (Bandai Namco).

Very Little Nightmares is a puzzle adventure game where you are tasked with escaping The Nest, a giant maze littered with traps.

Industry observers note that enjoy the incredibly atmospheric Limbo as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You play as a young boy who is looking for his sister and must traverse a deadly world to find her by solving puzzles and jumping over perilous gaps.

Old Man's Journey+ (Broken Rules).

Old Man's Journey+ is an emotional adventure that focuses on life's precious moments and aims that need to be changed.

Monument Valley 2+ (ustwo games).

The critically acclaimed adventure game Monument Valley 2 is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it sees players guiding a mother and her child through a world filled with magical architecture.

Gibbon: Beyond the Trees (Broken Rules).

The developers of Old Man's Journey and ELOH has returned with a game that looks to emulate the way gibbons swing from tree to tree. Meanwhile, the narrative tackles topics such as deforestation, poaching, and climate change.

Recent findings suggest that wylde Flowers is a life and farming sim, but with magical spells thrown in for good measure. You take on the role of Tara, who arrives on the island to help her grandma with the family farm. It promises to provide a whole adventure as you explore magical realms, beaches and forests.

Dandara: Trials of Fear+ (Raw Fury).

Raw Fury's Metroidvania Dandara: Trials of Fear can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you battling to save the world of Salt from an imminent collapse.

LEGO Star Wars: Castaways (Gameloft).

In Star Wars: Castaways, you will explore a mysterious planet that has been abandoned for a long time. Throughout the game, you will make new friends and battle against some imposing enemies.

In Monument Valley, you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the completely wild.

A beautiful adventure game that explores how everyone can make a difference in the world even with the smallest of actions.

Industry observers note that all of You is a cute, purely visual, accessible, family-friendly puzzle adventure with unique gameplay. Play and pause time in every part of the level to unveil the right path for the main character.

The Last Campfire is an adventure, a story of a lost ember trapped in a puzzling place, searching for meaning and a way home.

The ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

Sequel to the classic adventure game Beneath a Steel Sky.

Beyond Blue takes you into the near future, where you’ll have the opportunity to explore the mysteries of our ocean through the eyes of Mirai, a deep-sea explorer and scientist.

Industry observers note that live the life of a Sasquatch and do regular, everyday Sasquatch stuff like: Sneak around campsites. Disguise yourself in human clothing.

FreeCell Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Pretty much as it says on the tin. FreeCell Solitaire lets you enjoy the classic card game in as straightforward a way as possible. No bells and whistles needed here.

Uno: Arcade Edition (Mattel163).

If ruining long-standing friendships is your idea of fun, then you might want to give Uno: Arcade Edition a try. It's the classic card game we all love to get frustrated by with a few intriguing twists to the existing formula.

Crazy Eights: Card Games+ (MobilityWare).

Industry observers note that dip into some of your favourite tabletop card games with Crazy Eights. It has numerous modes to enjoy that mix up the rules, helping keep things fresh.

Texas Hold'em Poker: Pokerist+ (KamaGames).

No real surprises here, simply a way to play poker online, pitting your skills against other players to win significant.

LocalThunk's Balatro exploded in popularity when it released early in 2024. The simple concept of creating strong poker hands combined with deckbuilding, tactics and even some maths has led to it being viewed as one of the best games of the year. And now you can play it on your phone!

Monster Train+ (Good Shepherd Entertainment).

If you haven't played this excellent roguelike deckbuilder and happen to have an Apple Arcade subscription, you're now in luck. Monster Train sees you riding on the titular locomotive on a journey to restore a frozen hell to its former glory. Well, if hell is ever glorious, I suppose.

Blackjack by Mobility (Mobility Ware).

Industry observers note that this one's fairly self-explanatory, you can play the card game 21. You have unlimited chips too, so you can play against the dealer to your heart's content.

Pocket Card Jockey: Ride On (Game Freak).

Sources indicate that pocket Card Jockey: Ride On is a game that combines solitaire and horse racing. The game previously released on Nintendo 3DS but is now available as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Gin Rummy Classic+ (MobilityWare).

It has been revealed that learn to play Gin Rummy using tutorials and perfect your skills against bots offline. The aim is simple: you want to create the best hand possible by picking up or drawing one card at a time.

Spider Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Enjoy the classic card game Spider Solitaire as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Hearts: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

It has been revealed that now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

It has been revealed that the addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a fresh game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaires.

Pusheen's Place (Electric Square).

If the idea of adorable cat-like creatures appeals to you, then Pusheens is worth checking out. You'll gather a veritable army of them before popping them in their latest home, which you can also customise.

Unpacking is a Zen puzzler that sees you moving house several times over a period of time. It's entirely designed for relaxing, so you don't have to worry about timers, scores or any of that business. Just kick back and enjoy.

A bunch of evil monsters and villains need serving, and it's up to you to fulfil their orders.

The most famous and most popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Race along those tracks and grab coins to your heart's content without fear of any adverts of in-app purchases required.

Cleaning might not sound fun on the surface, but trust me, you'll love it in PowerWash Simulator. Armed with a powerful jet washer, you'll have to blast the muck off house, vehicles and other objects until they're spick and span. It's incredibly satisfying.

It has been revealed that piffle+ sees you slinging adorable cats around levels to break all the blocks. It's a simple premise, but trickier to do in practice.

Suika Game is deceptively simple. All you have to do is get two of the same fruit to come into contact with one another so they merge to form a larger fruit, with the ultimate goal being to create a watermelon. It sounds straightforward and perhaps a little dull, but before you know it, an hour's passed and you'll be itching to make more watermelons.

Helix Jump tasks you with guiding your ball through a series of twisted towers using physics-based movement.

There are few games as synonymous with mobile as Doodle Jump, and now this classic is available on Apple Arcade. The concept is simple, yet inherently compulsive. You can waste many hours on this one.

Talking Tom Blast Park (Outfit7).

Another entry in Outfit7's popular franchises, Talking Tom Blast Park sees the titular hero embarking on an adventure to stop Rakoonz.

Smash Hit+ sees you smash through an ethereal dimension in time with music. It promises to be a meditative experience despite the destruction you're leaving in your wake.

While Furista is a push as a pun, I'm happy for it count as a fan of felines. In this game, you adopt cats before matching your customers with them to make their visit to your cafe as fluffy and enjoyable as possible.

Sources indicate that collect and nurture fish so they become what they were always destined to be... Dragons! That's right. Zen Koi Pro+ is a relaxing experience that follows the Asian myth that koi can become dragons with enough care and attention.

Delicious – Miracle of Life+ (GameHouse).

Recent findings suggest that the popular casual management sim is now part of Apple Arcade. It follows Emily as she looks to progress her career while preparing to become a parent.

If you've ever wanted to build your own farm, this might be the game for you. Farmside allows you to place plots, plant crops and harvest them. Beyond that, you can raise animals and spend time designing your farm's layout.

Industry observers note that 2017's App Store Game of the Year is now available through Apple Arcade. The aim is simple, you have to search for the titular hidden folks across numerous levels. There are over 300 in total with 32 hand-drawn areas to investigate.

Another of MobilityWare's card games is now available on Apple Arcade. This time you can play Spades as much as you'd like. The aim is to work with a partner to try and out-bid your opponents while trying to reach 250 points first.

It has been revealed that now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

It has been revealed that the addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a new game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaire games.

Blast off into outer space with an intergalactic indie rock band in the latest instalment in the popular Reigns series.

Bring your friends and see how far you can get in this endless spinning tower of arcade fun! Keep climbing as high as you can. Every run is different.

Recent findings suggest that would you believe me if I told you that there's a puzzler about folding paper that's incredibly beautiful? If you're an origami fan, most likely. But to anyone else, it'll be a pleasant surprise in Kami 2+.

According to recent reports, block Blast is one of those simple yet endlessly engaging puzzlers. All you have to do is match blocks on an 8-by-8 grid and then enjoy them all exploding. However, it's never quite that simple, constantly asking you to think deeper than you might expect.

Art of Fauna: Cosy Puzzles+ (Klemens Strasser).

If you love nature and puzzles, then Art of Fauna is perfect for you. It sees you essentially putting together some beautiful artwork, with each accompanied by some text about the depicted animal.

Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ (Tripledot Studios).

A colourful and relaxing puzzler that will keep you occupied for hours and hours.

Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+ (Fanatee).

In a recent development, it's a bunch of puzzles you can do every day, right? Pretty much! There is a mix of word puzzles and brain teasers for you to tackle each day to keep your mind strong.

Recent findings suggest that fancy yourself as an artist? Draw It gives you the opportunity to prove it, tasking you with sketching out a visual depiction of a word before the time runs out.

Perchang World (Perchang World).

Sources indicate that perchang is a physics-based puzzler that takes you through a series of colour environments. It's wacky fun that's all narrated by popular British comedian, James Acaster.

Industry observers note that flow Free is as simple as puzzlers can get. However, don't expect it to be easy. Connect up colours might sound straightforward, but it becomes very tricky over time.

If you love pretty colours and solving puzzles, then I Love Hue Too+ is for you. It sees you rearranging mosaic tiles to make beautiful creations.

Sources indicate that let's Go Mightycat! (ponos corporation).

The Battle Cats now have a spin-off! Now you can fling them at blocky towers. It might sound straightforward, but making them all tumble to the ground isn't as easy as you might think.

Lost in Play+ (Snapbreak Games).

It has been revealed that lost in Play is a story about a brother and sister trying to find their way home. To do so, you will need to solve a series of puzzles alongside chatting with some whimsical creatures.

Words of Wonders: Search+ (Fugo Bilism).

Industry observers note that no great surprises here, Words of Wonder: Search+ is... a word search! That's right. It pretty much does exactly what it says on the tin. So if hunting for a list of words is your jam, you're well catered to here.

It has been revealed that sumi Sumi: Matching Puzzle+ (Imagineer Co. Ltd).

Sumi Sumi is a puzzler that tasks you with matching popular characters from San-X together while enjoying all the beautiful animations that accompany doing so.

What do you get if you mix stickers with jigsaws? puffies. That's what! Designed to be a calming experience, it tasks you with open sticker packs before piecing together the various puzzles.

Put your word skills to the test with Zynga's Arcade edition of the popular puzzler Boggle.

Wheel of Fortune Daily (Frosty Pop).

If you're a fan of Wheel of Fortune and fans of daily puzzles, this game is exactly what you're looking. Each day, you will have to solve one, with plenty of variety promising to keep it fresh every time.

Enjoy some match-3 puzzling with a delightful cast of colourful characters.

Super Monsters Ate My Condo+ (PikPok).

According to recent reports, super Monsters Ate My Condo brings some whacky match-3 to the table. This new and updated version offers improved visuals but, thankfully, leaves the gameplay we all know and love untouched.

The popular tile-matching puzzler comes to Apple Arcade. It sees you popping the titular Puyos across several different game modes.

Sources indicate that words in Progress sees you combining letters to create words. You can either find how long you can survive in Endless Mode or test your word crafting prowess against other players.

It has been revealed that cornsweeper promises to be a meditative puzzler where the aim is to avoid explosions going off. It draws heavy inspiration from Minesweeper, as you might have guessed by the name!

Puzzle & Dragons Story (GungHo Online Entertainment).

In a recent development, the popular series brings its blend of match-3 puzzling and RPG elements to Apple Arcade. By matching colours, you will battle your way through deadly dungeons while recruiting newly introduced companions to help you in the fight.

Knotwords is a word puzzler that brings together elements of Sudoku and crosswords.

Crossword Jam+ (PlaySimple Games).

Train your brain by engaging with a series of crossword-style games that see you looking to create words.

Sources indicate that om Nom is back in the third instalment in the popular puzzler series. The aim is to reunite Nibble Nom and Om Nom on each stage by engaging with the various mechanics that the game has to offer.

Recent findings suggest that finity. is a matching game with three simple rules to follow. But that doesn't mean it's going to be easy as you attempt to climb the leaderboards.

Nekograms is an adorable puzzler where the goal is to help every cat you encounter fall asleep. To do this, you have to move the felines and cushions around until they've found the perfect place to curl into a ball and nap.

Sources indicate that bold Moves+ is a puzzler where you match tiles to solve a series of word puzzles. It offers a mixture of daily and weekly events alongside plenty of levels to work through.

Disney SpellStruck (Artist Arcade).

Sources indicate that disney SpellStruck is a word puzzler that takes place on The Isles of Tiles. It tasks you with solving a bunch of crossword-like games with popular Disney and Pixar characters like Mickey Mouse, Stitch, and Tinkerbell.

Disney Getaway Blast+ (Gameloft).

Make your way through a series of matching puzzle games while working on your own tropical island. Along the way, you can get help from beloved Disney and Pixar characters, with each bringing special power-ups.

Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist (Tilting: Point).

Industry observers note that if you enjoy the popular BBC sci-fi series and puzzlers, then Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist might be for you. It sees you finding hidden objects and solving a series of puzzles.

Industry observers note that human: Fall Flat+ is now available on Apple Arcade. It's a jokey physics-based platformer that can be enjoyed on your own or with four pals.

Castle Crumble (Orbital Knight).

It has been revealed that if the title didn't make it clear enough, Castle Crumble is all about toppling strongholds. Using a mixture of explosives and spells, you will travel through different time periods destroying castles as you go.

According to recent reports, illustrated is a puzzler where the solutions lie in the images in front of you as well as the story. When you beat each story, each illustration is unveiled in full colour.

As the name implies, stitch. is a game all about embroidery. The aim is to fill in each area without leaving any gaps. The game calls them Hoops, and they come in different shapes and sizes, ranging from landscapes to plants to animals.

Garden Tails: Match and Grow (Playdots).

Garden Tails: Match and Grow is a relaxing puzzler for fans of wildlife and nature. It sees you building your own garden by completing match-3 puzzles to unlock new flowers, bushes and critters.

Jigsaw Puzzle by MobilityWare+ (MobilityWare).

In a recent development, jigsaw Puzzle is exactly what it says on the tin. You can sit back, relax, and solve a series of jigsaw puzzles. There are 26,000 of them in total from well-known brands, including Disney and Hasbro.

Prune is a beautiful game that serves as a love letter to nature, and specifically trees. It sees you growing and shaping your tree with simple swipe controls. The goal is to guide them towards the sunlight while avoiding the many dangers the world presents.

Moonshot – A Journey Home (Noodlecake).

Industry observers note that moonshot is a physics-based puzzler that tasks you with guiding Moon Pi – a moon who has become separated from Earth – back home. It uses drag and release mechanics as you launch Moon Pi past the gravity fields of other planets. There are also other obstacles to dodge, such as black holes and aliens.

It has been revealed that as the title suggests, Bridge Constructor tests players' bridge assembly prowess across 40 levels. You will need to make sure they can withstand constant use from cars and other heavy vehicles like trucks and super-heavy tank trucks.

Splitter Critters+ (RAC7 Games).

Splitter Critters is a cute puzzler where the aim is to guide the little creatures safely back to their spaceship. To do this you will be able to split the world into different pieces to create a path the critters can traverse.

It has been revealed that temple Run: Puzzle Adventure is a match-3 take on the well-known franchise. You will look to create powerful combs to make special pieces that allow you to become a Temple Champion.

Zookeeper World is a match-3 puzzler that allows players to create their own zoo. The more levels they beat, the more animals, plants and accessories they'll unlock to use in their zoo.

Checkers, your latest free checker game (also known as Draughts), will entertain you for hours! It’s challenging with 5 different levels, yet relaxing and beautiful with 8 different designs.

When the tranquillity of suburban life is threatened by a huge building site, Simon and his cat mobilise the neighbours to help restore the mysterious wasteland before the diggers destroy it all.

A 3-D colour-matching game that sees players being tasked with toppling a series of mysterious towers that have appeared in the kingdom.

A quiet, sombre adventure best experienced with a loved one.

Eat loads of pills and pellets while chasing ghosts with your friends!

Embark on an epic hand-animated adventure from Zach Gage, Pendleton Ward, and Choice Provisions. Cast powerful spells, slay fantastic monsters, discover ancient secrets, and ultimately save the world — just by picking up the right cards.

Dear Reader lets you curl up and play your favourite books, turning classic literature into clever word puzzles. Unscramble passages from famous books, unlock unique puzzles and add new books to your library.

In a recent development, grindstone is a puzzle-meets-action hybrid that will see you slashing through dozens of meaningless monsters on a path of destruction and carnage. Beautiful.

Patterned is a unique puzzle game that immerses you in the beauty and joy of seamless, repeating patterns.

Industry observers note that tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolours to match the colour of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio.

Industry observers note that where Cards Fall is a slice-of-life story where you build houses of cards to bring formative memories to life. Create pathways through dreamlike spatial puzzles to navigate the insecurities and emotions of high school and beyond.

Lego Hill Climb Adventures+ (Fingersoft).

Lego Hill Climb Adventures brings a mixture of exploration, racing, and upgrading to the table, all presented with everyone's favourite building blocks.

Lego Friends Heartlake Rush+ (StoryToys Limited).

Hop in various Lego vehicles and race through Heartlake City in high-octane action that sees you dodging traffic and roadblocks on your journey to be the fastest pile of bricks on the course.

Hot Wheels: Race Off+ (Hutch Games).

Enjoy some Hot Wheels-branded racing action in this game with all the loop the loops you could ever hope for.

Hill Climb Racing+ (Fingersoft).

The classic game is now available on Apple Arcade. You play as Bill, an aspiring uphill racer as he drives a series of unique vehicles up hills and over obstacles.

Horizon Chase 2 is a fast-paced arcade racer with gameplay inspired by the genre's best entries from the '90s.

In a recent development, gear.Club Stradale is all about supercars. You and your friends can start your own club in Tuscany, Italy and drive expensive cars from manufacturers like Bugatti, Porsche and McLaren.

Race with your favourite characters from several beloved cartoons, such as American Dad!, Family Guy, King of the Hill and Solar Opposite.

Enjoy Gameloft's popular racing game without any microtransactions. There are over 250 licensed vehicles from the likes of Ferrari, Ducati, Lamborghini and many more.

Race on mobile with Sonic and his friends.

Dungeon Clawler+ (Stray Fawn Studio).

According to recent reports, dungeon Clawler is a roguelike deckbuilder that uses the claw machine as a way to grab various items. It's a fun twist on the usual formula, and this claw actually grabs things, unlike those you find in UK arcades.

Hyke: Northerine Light(s) (Akatsuki Games).

According to recent reports, if you like your RPGs doused in pixelated goodness, then you might want to check out Hyke. Playing as the titular character, you set out on a journey to find your missing mother. Along the way, Hyke's witch powers will come in handy against the threats you face.

Black Salt Games' excellent Dredge has now moored on Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's essentially a relaxing fishing sim, until it suddenly isn't. You see, Eldritch nightmares are lurking in the depths that will do their best to destroy your humble vessel.

Final Fantasy IV: The After Years+ (Square Enix).

According to recent reports, ever wondered what happened after Final Fantasy IV? Well, in The After Years, you can play out that tale. This version is a full 3D remake too, so it looks better than ever.

Final Fantasy IV (3D Remake) + (Square Enix).

You can now play the 1991 classic on your iPhone or iPad with additional features compared to the original.

Stardew Valley+ (Concerned Ape).

Stardew Valley is a game that needs no introduction if you've previously indulged in its cosy world of breeding animals and growing crops. If you are unfamiliar, it's an open-ended RPG where you can not only manage a farm but also settle down and make a family while participating in community events.

Slay the Spire+ (Humble Bundle).

In a recent development, the quintessential deck-building roguelike is now available on Apple Arcade. Slay the Spire has remained at the top of this sub-genre because it's still comfortably one of the best.

My Town Home – Family Games+ (My Town Games).

Explore a doll's house with over six different rooms to explore. There are multiple members of the family to meet, each with a different pet.

Episode XOXO (Episode Interactive).

Episode XOXO promises a constantly growing library of interactive stories where your choices will influence the narrative.

First rolled out in 2014, Battleheart Legacy is now available on Apple Arcade. You can choose from several typical fantasy classes before heading into battle to vanquish nasty beasties.

In this crafting-based RPG, you will take on the role of Flux Dabes, a galactic trucker who needs to recover his missing packages after becoming stranded on an alien planet.

It has been revealed that embark on an adventure where you will collect Monsties and form bonds with them. This revamped version of the game includes graphical improvements and a better user interface.

Fantasian is an exciting, upcoming RPG set against a spectacular backdrop made from over 150 handmade dioramas that blend physical environments and 3D characters.

Engage in an epic storyline for control of the mysterious Nexus and the fate of the universe as players step into the role of their favourite Star Trek heroes and villains in the hit franchise's official team-based RPG.

Join the Crystal Gems for the ultimate mobile RPG. It’s time to Unleash the Light!

Unleash the Light features an original story co-written by Rebecca Sugar, and voiceover from the Steven Universe cast and special guest star Christine Baranski.

It has been revealed that A young Knight faces an impossible challenge, as Warlock Mesmeroth has returned with a formidable Dark Army. Will our hero be able to unite the Owrus, Gillfolk, and men in a fight for the fate of the world?

Food Stylist – Design Game+ (Zeste).

While food is mainly for eating, that doesn't mean it can't look good too. In Food Stylist, that's your job: make every dish look as good as it tastes.

Pocket City 2+ (Engaged Labs Inc).

As the name implies, Pocket City 2 sees you creating your own city. But it's not all stuffy business meetings and financials. You can also participate in street races and basketball challenges. It's a fun place, evidently.

Industry observers note that outfit7's popular virtual pet sim is now on Apple Arcade! You'll have to look after your latest pal, making sure he's fed and happy.

If running a coffee empire is something you've always dreamed of, then now is your chance to make it a reality. Well, virtually, anyway. And it's not just one place either; you can expand your business across the world, taking over Tokyo, Paris, Berlin, and Amsterdam. Watch out, Starbucks.

Good Pizza, Great Pizza+ (Tapblaze).

Industry observers note that who doesn't like pizza? Anyone who answers that question with “Me” simply cannot be trusted. I'm sure we all agree. In Good Pizza, Great Pizza, you get to run your own business, serving customers one of the greatest foods ever created.

Recent findings suggest that before houses became incredibly hard to afford, the dream was building your own home with your partner. Pocket Love!+ allows you to make it a virtual reality in a cute and cosy package.

Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story+ (Kairosoft).

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that even before the game came out, it was pretty easy to guess that Nioh 3 would be a hit.
  • Today, publisher Koei Tecmo has announced that the game has officially passed over one million copies sold worldwide across PC, and PlayStation 5.
  • In a recent development, as a result of this fantastic launch, Nioh 3 has now pushed overall Nioh franchise sales to be over 10 million, which includes the original Nioh as well as Nioh 2.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that even before the game came out, it was pretty easy to guess that Nioh 3 would be a hit. From the word of mouth leading up to launch, to the well-received free demo, there was little chance the action RPG wasn’t going to be a major deal.

Today, publisher Koei Tecmo has announced that the game has officially passed over one million copies sold worldwide across PC, and PlayStation 5. This makes it the fastest in the Nioh franchise to reach this milestone.

In a recent development, as a result of this fantastic launch, Nioh 3 has now pushed overall Nioh franchise sales to be over 10 million, which includes the original Nioh as well as Nioh 2. Today’s news comes just two weeks after the game arrived on PC, and PS5.

Industry observers note that on Steam, where it’s available on PC, it shot up the Steam charts, and immediately broke the series’ previous best peak concurrent player count record. From there, the numbers kept growing, leading up to a stellar weekend where it peaked at 88,045 concurrent players on Steam, double that of its launch day.

This now stands as the largest for any Nioh game on Steam, and though we don’t have insight into how well it’s doing on PS5 specifically, it still demonstrates that the Nioh series continues to grow.

It has been revealed that nioh 3 builds on everything the two prior games established, and pushes the series into the semi-open-world realm, with several larger maps that each cover a period of time in Japan’s history. In our Nioh 3 review we called it “Team Ninja’s most accomplished action game, and the series’ most accessible.”.

If you’re curious about the challenging and very rewarding action RPG, start with these gameplay tips, and don’t be shy to call upon a friend (or stranger) for help using our co-op guide.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Britain's Marc 'Caedrel' Lamont and Dan Gaskin were among the winners at the 2026 Esports Awards in Miami, where Counter-Strike 2 was named game of the year and Team Vitality and BLAST also took industry honours. The results crown a strong Counter-Strike year eight days before the next CS2 Major begins in Singapore.

Industry observers note that the 2026 Esports Awards honoured two British figures from the streaming and broadcast side of the scene. Caedrel is a League of Legends streamer and co-streamer. Gaskin works as a caster.

The ceremony took place on the evening of 17 November at the Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts of Miami-Dade County. It is the scene’s main end-of-season awards show. The event began in London in 2016.

At Worlds 2026, Caedrel was the top co-streamer for both hours watched and peak viewers, according to Esports Charts.

Recent findings suggest that his co-stream success came in a softer year for the tournament overall. Worlds 2026 peaked at 3.98 million viewers, which was 41% lower than the previous year. Caedrel’s numbers show how much attention a single co-streamer can hold even when the event’s headline peak falls.

According to recent reports, gaskin was not the only caster honoured in Miami. The other broadcast honours went to Alex ‘Machine’ Richardson for Play-by-Play Caster of the Year, Iain Chambers for Host of the Year and Anthony ‘NAMELESS’ Wheeler for Analyst of the Year. iShowSpeed was named Streamer of the Year.

Sources indicate that counter-Strike featured prominently among the industry prizes. Vitality’s award as best organisation came alongside Esports PC Player of the Year for Mathieu ‘ZywOo’ Herbaut. OpTic Texas were named Esports Team of the Year.

BLAST, which stages many of its events in Europe, was named Esports Tournament Organiser of the Year.

Industry observers note that vitality’s results through the year back up their award. They beat Spirit to win IEM Rio 2026 on 19 April, giving them back-to-back ESL Grand Slam titles. ZywOo took his 31st career HLTV MVP award at that event.

"When I won this award in 2023, I never thanked my parents" 😅❤️.

Esports Colour Caster of the Year — @DanGaskin pic.twitter.com/oZBw5FItEJ.

— Esports Awards Presented by Thunderpick (@esportsawards) November 18, 2026.

Sources indicate that the team’s form held into the autumn. Vitality swept MOUZ 3-0 in the ESL Pro League Season 24 grand final on 11 October. That was their second title in a row after winning StarSeries Fall in September.

Sources indicate that the PGL Major Singapore 2026 runs from 25 November to 13 December with 32 teams and a US$1,250,000 prize pool, The Kallang reported. The final stages will be played at the Singapore Indoor Stadium from 10 to 13 December.
